_comment: New questions for comparing vector, keyword, and hybrid retrieval on the five documents from 04-chunking (copied unchanged into documents/). Written before any keyword-search code existed. 'category': identifier (the question is built around an exact string from the documents: an error code, header, field, URL, or version), paraphrase (the question shares at most one content word with its evidence), mixed (an exact string plus a concept in the question's own words). Evidence and scoring as in questions-04.json: each alternative is a set of passages copied exactly from the documents (each occurs exactly once); a question's evidence is found when, for at least one alternative, every passage is whole inside one retrieved chunk (different passages may be in different chunks). 'split': alternating within each category in the order written, starting with dev; dev questions choose settings (the fusion weight), test questions report results. questions-04.json holds the 60 questions from 04-chunking, unchanged, reported separately.

questions.question: What does SSO-104 mean?
questions.answer: The Entity ID doesn't match; copy the Entity ID again from Settings > Security > SSO.

evidence.text: | Error code | Meaning | What to do |
| SSO-104 | The Entity ID doesn't match |

questions.question: The API returned cursor_expired. What happened?
questions.answer: The pagination cursor is more than 24 hours old; start again from the first page.

evidence.text: | Status | Code | Meaning |
| 400 | cursor_expired | The pagination cursor is more than 24 hours old |
a request with an expired cursor receives 400 with the error code cursor_expired

questions.question: What is idempotency_mismatch?
questions.answer: A 409 error: the idempotency key was already used with a different body.

evidence.text: | Status | Code | Meaning |
| 409 | idempotency_mismatch | The idempotency key was already used with a different body |
Reusing a key with a different body receives 409 with the code idempotency_mismatch.

questions.question: What does the X-RateLimit-Remaining header contain?
questions.answer: How many requests are left in the current rate-limit window.

evidence.text: | Header | Meaning |
| X-RateLimit-Remaining | How many requests are left in the current window |

questions.question: What is the Idempotency-Key header for?
questions.answer: Retrying POST requests safely: a repeat with the same key and body within 24 hours returns the original response.

evidence.text: To retry safely, send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value

questions.question: What does SSO-102 mean?
questions.answer: The SAML response is older than 5 minutes; check the identity provider's clock.

evidence.text: | Error code | Meaning | What to do |
| SSO-102 | The response is older than 5 minutes |

questions.question: What was fixed in version 6.0?
questions.answer: Due dates entered on mobile were saved in the device's time zone instead of the profile's.

evidence.text: Due dates entered on mobile were saved in the device's time zone

questions.question: When is the task.deleted event sent?
questions.answer: When a task is moved to Trash.

evidence.text: | Event | Sent when |
| task.deleted | A task is moved to Trash |

questions.question: What is https://api.example.com/scim/v2 used for?
questions.answer: It is the base URL for SCIM provisioning, entered in the identity provider with the SCIM token.

evidence.text: turn on SCIM provisioning. Use the base URL https://api.example.com/scim/v2

questions.question: What does a 503 with the code maintenance mean?
questions.answer: Scheduled maintenance; retry after the time in Retry-After.

evidence.text: | Status | Code | Meaning |
| 503 | maintenance | Scheduled maintenance; retry after the time in Retry-After |

questions.question: What is https://app.example.com/sso/acs?
questions.answer: The Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL to paste into the identity provider when setting up SAML.

evidence.text: the Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL, https://app.example.com/sso/acs

questions.question: What does parent_id do on a task?
questions.answer: It makes the task a subtask of another task in the same project.

evidence.text: | Field | Type | Notes |
| parent_id | string or null | Set to make the task a subtask of another task in the same project |

questions.question: What does include_completed=false do?
questions.answer: It leaves completed subtasks out of the task list.

evidence.text: Completed subtasks are included unless you pass include_completed=false.

questions.question: What is the X-Timestamp header on webhooks?
questions.answer: One of the two signature headers; it is signed with the body and must be no more than 5 minutes old.

evidence.text: Each request has two headers: X-Signature and X-Timestamp.
5. Check that X-Timestamp is no more than 5 minutes old.

questions.question: What does a Sunset header in an API response tell me?
questions.answer: The date when a deprecated endpoint or version will stop working.

evidence.text: a Sunset header with the date it will stop working

questions.question: How do I stop people signing in from outside our office network?
questions.answer: Use the IP allowlist (Pro): limit sign-ins and API requests to a list of IP ranges under Settings > Security > IP allowlist.

evidence.text: Admins can limit sign-ins and API requests to a list of IP address ranges
Admins can limit sign-ins and API requests to up to 50 IP address ranges.

questions.question: A laptop was stolen. Can I force all our staff to log in again immediately?
questions.answer: Yes: Sign out all members under Settings > Security > Sessions.

evidence.text: To sign everyone out now, for example after a suspected breach, use Sign out all members on the same page.

questions.question: Someone is taking a six-month sabbatical. Can I block them temporarily without them losing what they're responsible for?
questions.answer: Suspend them: they can't sign in, but keep their role, projects, and task assignments.

evidence.text: Suspending is for people who will be away for a while
but they keep their role, their project memberships, and their task assignments

questions.question: Can coworkers with our corporate address get in on their own, without me adding each one?
questions.answer: Yes: turn on Allowed email domains under Settings > Members > Joining.

evidence.text: To let people join without an invitation, turn on Allowed email domains

questions.question: Our accountant needs copies of the bills automatically. How?
questions.answer: Add their address as a billing contact under Settings > Billing > Invoice details.

evidence.text: add their address as a billing contact under Settings > Billing > Invoice details

questions.question: We're a German company with a tax ID. Will you add tax to our charges?
questions.answer: No: with a valid VAT number, the reverse-charge mechanism applies and no VAT is added.

evidence.text: unless you enter a valid VAT number under Settings > Billing > Invoice details; then the reverse-charge mechanism applies and no VAT is added

questions.question: If someone breaks into your systems and our information is exposed, how quickly will we hear about it?
questions.answer: Without undue delay, and within 48 hours at the latest.

evidence.text: we notify the Owner without undue delay, and in any case within 48 hours

questions.question: How long after we stop paying can we still get our stuff back?
questions.answer: 90 days: you can export or reactivate during that time.

evidence.text: After the plan ends, your data is kept for 90 days.
customer data is kept for 90 days so that the customer can export it or reactivate the subscription

questions.question: Can I see who did what, and when, in our workspace?
questions.answer: Yes, in the audit log (Pro, Owner and Admins), under Settings > Security > Audit log.

evidence.text: The audit log records security-relevant events in the organization

questions.question: Is there a cap on how often a script can call you?
questions.answer: Yes: per key, per rolling minute (100 on Basic, 1,000 on Pro).

evidence.text: Limits apply per API key, over a rolling window of one minute.

questions.question: Our card keeps getting declined. Will my team lose access?
questions.answer: After the third failed retry the organization becomes read-only: people can sign in and view, but not create or edit.

evidence.text: If the third retry also fails, the organization becomes read-only
members can sign in and view everything, but nobody can create or edit anything

questions.question: Can I get my money back if we change our minds a week after buying?
questions.answer: Yes: refunds can be requested within 30 days of purchase, through live chat.

evidence.text: You can request a refund within 30 days of purchase, through live chat.

questions.question: Who else handles our information on your behalf?
questions.answer: Subprocessors in four categories: cloud infrastructure, email delivery, payment processing, and live chat.

evidence.text: We use the following categories of subprocessors.
| Cloud infrastructure | Hosting the app
| Email delivery | Sending notifications
| Payment processing | Charging cards
| Live chat | Support conversations |

questions.question: Do I pay extra for every person I add?
questions.answer: No: prices are per organization, not per member.

evidence.text: Prices are per organization, not per member

questions.question: Can we move our account from the US servers to Germany?
questions.answer: Not directly: the region can't be changed; create a new organization in the other region and export and import the data.

evidence.text: To move to the other region, create a new organization there, export your data from the old one, and import it into the new one.

questions.question: Since a payment failed, our script gets 423 errors. What do we need to do?
questions.answer: The organization is read-only (organization_read_only); update the card, which retries the payment and makes it writable again.

evidence.text: | 423 | organization_read_only |
Updating the card retries the overdue payment immediately, and the organization becomes writable again

questions.question: We get 429 even though we only retry failed requests. Why?
questions.answer: Requests that receive 429 still count toward the limit, so retrying immediately makes the wait longer; wait for Retry-After.

evidence.text: Requests that receive 429 still count toward the limit, so retrying immediately in a loop makes the wait longer.

questions.question: Will page and per_page pagination still work next year?
questions.answer: Only until 2027-03-31: version 1, which uses them, is deprecated; move to cursor pagination.

evidence.text: Version 1 was deprecated on 2026-06-01 and will stop working on 2027-03-31. Version 1 used offset pagination with page and per_page parameters

questions.question: Can I make a guest the assignee of a task through the API?
questions.answer: Yes, if they are a guest of that project: assignee takes the email of a member or a guest of the project.

evidence.text: | Field | Type | Notes |
| assignee | string or null | The email address of a member or a guest of the project |

questions.question: We get 403 forbidden when we call the API from home. Could that be the office-only network setting?
questions.answer: Yes: 403 forbidden is also returned for requests from outside the IP allowlist.

evidence.text: | Status | Code | Meaning |
| 403 | forbidden | The key's member isn't allowed to do this, or the request came from outside the IP allowlist |

questions.question: Do people created through SCIM become Admins?
questions.answer: No: they join with the Member role; change the role in the app.

evidence.text: Members created through SCIM join with the Member role

questions.question: Does Sign out all members log me out too?
questions.answer: No: the person who uses it stays signed in.

evidence.text: use Sign out all members on the same page. The person who uses it stays signed in.

questions.question: Will the IP allowlist block your webhook calls to our server?
questions.answer: No: webhook deliveries are not affected, because they go from your servers to ours.

evidence.text: Webhook deliveries are not affected, because they go from our servers to yours.

questions.question: How much is Pro per year, and how does that compare with paying monthly?
questions.answer: $250 per year, the same as 10 months of monthly billing at $25.

evidence.text: | Annual price | $100 | $250 |
An annual plan costs the same as 10 months of monthly billing.

questions.question: What's the longest title a task can have?
questions.answer: 500 characters.

evidence.text: | Field | Type | Notes |
| title | string | Required, 1 to 500 characters |
